creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From tooling feedback, 2026-10-17, 0.16.1-dev on the Mac, twice. `muster pane compact --pane <helper> "<focus>" --then "<next brief>"` exited 0 with no output. The compaction ran: context went to 0%, and the transcript shows `/compact` and `Compacted`. The `--then` prompt never appeared, and the Claude Code helper sat idle at an empty prompt until its maker sent the same text with `muster msg post`, which started it at once. The first time, Claude Code's "Heads up" tip box showed above the prompt; the second time nothing did, so the tip box is not the cause.

`--then` came with a_2izzbA9cT, and the daemon takes it in `Compaction::ask` (`crates/muster-daemon/src/compaction.rs`). Find where the prompt is dropped. Then have the CLI or the daemon say when a `--then` prompt was not taken, as `pane send --confirm` does, since otherwise the maker learns of it only from an idle notice.
title: pane compact --then exits 0, and its prompt never reaches the compacted agent
